Bitcoin-based Liquid Network reports $320 million stolen in hack

The Bitcoin-based Liquid Network reported that approximately $320 million worth of cryptocurrency was withdrawn from its federation wallet in a hack. The incident involved the withdrawal of around 4,000 of the 4,200 Bitcoin held in the Liquid Federation wallet. Liquid Network, which develops a blockchain for faster transactions, stated that the funds were withdrawn by "purported white-hat hackers." The total amount stolen is reported to be $320 million.
